text: Qatar Holding LLC was the third-largest shareholder in Volkswagen AG at the end of 2025, with 17.0% of the voting rights; the annual report's shareholder-structure chart shows it with 10.4% of the subscribed capital.

source.name: Volkswagen Group Annual Report 2025: Shareholder structure
source.quote: Qatar Holding LLC was the third-largest shareholder with 17.0%.

additionalSources.name: AGBI: Volkswagen’s troubles sour Qatari investment (archived)
additionalSources.quote: Qatar paid “in excess of” €7 billion for options that ultimately led it to acquire 10 percent of Volkswagen Group – including 17 percent voting rights – plus 10 percent of Porsche.
